# CC-CEDICT attribution

`hanzi-meanings.js` contains a reduced character-gloss subset generated from **CC-CEDICT**, a community-maintained Chinese–English dictionary published by MDBG.

- Project: https://cc-cedict.org/
- Download source: https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/export/cedict/
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
- License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode

The reduced data subset remains available under CC BY-SA 4.0. The game adds no corrections to the upstream dictionary; it selects and condenses entries needed by the displayed training text.
